title: Split finite projective summands yield a flat nonsplit limit of projective dimension one

statement.quantifiers: Countable ring R=F2[G], R-linear U,V with VU1 and nonzero E=im(I−UV); inherited residual dual identified with R/M.
statement.assertion: M=directsum_(n>=0)U^nE is projective non-finitely-generated; Q=R/M is flat nonprojective, pd_R Q1, pure nonsplit quotient extension and |Ext^1_R(Q,R)|=continuum.
assumptions: E nonzero finitely generated projective; U,V are exact R-module endomorphisms.
Countability of R for the continuum-cardinality consequence.
Pontryagin residual identification is imported from earlier algebraic setup.

inputs: Exact split one-sided endomorphisms and the full countable residual quotient, not finite truncations alone.
outputs: Global algebraic nonsplitting and an exact flat direct-limit realization; no nonlinear measurable impossibility.
interface.precision: Exact algebraic identities, no approximate numerical substitute.

Classical homological algebra is used; historical priority/external correctness unresolved.

proof_mechanism: Use VE0,VU1 to show independent copies E_n and R=M_N directsum U^N R.
Finite generators stay in one invariant M_N, so M not finitely generated.
A projective quotient would make M a summand of cyclic R, contradiction.
Projective M gives length-one resolution; colimit of free R under V identifies the quotient and gives flatness/purity.
Hom(M,R)=product Hom(E_n,R), each nontrivial countable; quotient by countable Hom(R,R) retains continuum size.
obstructions: Every finite truncation splits despite the infinite extension failing.
Failure of a continuous equivariant group section does not exclude nonlinear measurable absorption.
Do not identify this nonprojective quotient with the distinct projective module Rp.
